title: Signature Global Rosalia — 2BHK Apartment in Sector 84

scenes.title: Welcoming Entrance Foyer
scenes.description: A bright entry foyer floored in large ivory tiles, with a wooden shoe rack, a 'HOME' key holder and a framed mirror by the panelled main door. From here the home opens up: a wide archway on the left leads into the open-plan living and dining room, while a passage on the right reaches the common bathroom and the bedroom corridor.
scenes.caption: Bright tiled entry foyer
scenes.narration_script: Welcome to the Signature Global Rosalia residence. As you step in through the main door, you are standing in a neat little foyer with a shoe rack and a key hook to your left. Turn to your left and the home opens straight into a sunlit living and dining space, and just to your right a short passage leads you to the common bathroom and on toward the bedrooms. Let's head into the living room first.

scenes.title: Open-Plan Living & Dining Room
scenes.description: A spacious open-plan living and dining room with a deep sage-green L-shaped sofa, a low wooden coffee table and a wall-mounted television on a sleek wooden console. Towards the centre a six-seater dining table sits beside a curtained glass door that opens onto the road-facing balcony, and a stainless-steel refrigerator marks the kitchen on the far side. Doorways along the inner wall lead to the master bedroom and the common bathroom, and a doorway by the TV returns to the entrance foyer.
scenes.caption: Sage sofa, sunlit open-plan lounge
scenes.narration_script: This is the heart of the home, a generous open-plan living and dining room. Notice the comfortable L-shaped sofa facing the wall-mounted television, and just beyond, the dining table set near the balcony's glass door where light pours in. To one side the refrigerator hints at the kitchen, while the inner doorways open to the bedroom and the common bathroom. From here you can step out onto the balcony, into the kitchen, or back to the entrance.

scenes.title: Well-Equipped Modular Kitchen
scenes.description: An L-shaped modular kitchen finished in warm wood cabinetry with a dark granite countertop. It is fully fitted with a gas cooktop under a chimney hood, a sink beneath a grilled window, a stainless-steel refrigerator and ample glass-front storage stocked with jars. A small breakfast table with two stools tucks into the corner, and an open doorway leads back to the living and dining area.
scenes.caption: Granite-top modular kitchen
scenes.narration_script: Step into the modular kitchen, wrapped in warm wood cabinets with a dark granite counter. You have a gas cooktop with a chimney above, a sink set beneath a window that lets in daylight, and plenty of storage in the glass-front cabinets. There is even a cosy breakfast nook with two stools in the corner. When you're ready, the doorway here takes you straight back to the living and dining room.

scenes.title: Spacious Master Bedroom
scenes.description: A roomy master bedroom with a large double bed dressed in soft blue linen, flanked by matching wooden nightstands and lamps. A tall wardrobe and a wide dresser provide generous storage, while a curtained glass door on the outer wall fills the room with daylight and opens toward the balcony. The wide entry door connects to the living and dining area, and an attached bathroom sits just off the room.
scenes.caption: Sunlit master bedroom with wardrobe
scenes.narration_script: Here is the master bedroom, a calm and spacious retreat. A large double bed sits centre stage with bedside lamps on either side, and you have a full-height wardrobe and a long dresser for storage. The curtained glass door along the far wall lets in lovely natural light and steps out toward the balcony. The main door brings you back to the living area, and the attached bathroom is right beside you.

scenes.title: Modern Common Bathroom
scenes.description: A clean, modern bathroom tiled in soft beige, with a vessel basin set on a wood-and-granite vanity, a wall-mounted toilet with a health faucet, and a glass-partitioned walk-in shower with a rain head. Towel rails, a mirror and a small ventilated window keep the space practical and bright. The single door opens back to the living area and entrance passage.
scenes.caption: Glass-shower modern bathroom
scenes.narration_script: This is the home's modern bathroom. You have a stylish vessel basin on a wooden vanity, a wall-hung toilet, and a glass-partitioned shower area with a rain shower head, all finished in calm beige tile. A small window keeps it well ventilated. The door here leads back out to the living area and the entrance.

scenes.title: Road-Facing City-View Balcony
scenes.description: A long road-facing balcony with a glass-and-steel railing that opens to sweeping views of the surrounding high-rise towers and greenery. It doubles as a relaxed sit-out and utility space, with a cane armchair and glass table at one end, potted plants and planter boxes along the rail, and a clothes-drying rack and laundry hamper at the other. Glass sliding doors connect it back into the apartment.
scenes.caption: City-view balcony sit-out
scenes.narration_script: Step out onto the balcony and take in the open city view, with high-rise towers and greenery stretching to the horizon over the glass railing. There's a comfortable cane chair and table to sit with your morning tea, planters brightening the rail, and a practical drying area for laundry at the far end. When you're done enjoying the air, the sliding glass door takes you back inside.
